komunikaty.Hero.naglowek: You do the talking — Catherly keeps track of contacts and results.
komunikaty.Hero.podtytul: Catherly is a system for running your own direct selling — contacts, content, team, and results in one place.
komunikaty.Filary.filar1.naglowek: In the morning, you see who to reach out to.
komunikaty.Filary.filar1.korzysc: You have a plan for the day and a contact base that grows while you do the talking.
komunikaty.Filary.filar1.konkret1: The DMO sets the order of your conversations — you start the day without hesitating.
komunikaty.Filary.filar1.konkret2: A reminder just before each meeting — you walk in prepared, not caught off guard.
komunikaty.Filary.filar1.konkret3: Every referral arrives with a trail — you know who sent her your way.
komunikaty.Filary.filar2.naglowek: You write. Shield checks. Ethical Seal confirms.
komunikaty.Filary.filar2.korzysc: The Studio learns your voice and makes sure no piece of content breaks your rules.
komunikaty.Filary.filar2.konkret1: The Studio comes with ready formats and templates — you never face a blank page.
komunikaty.Filary.filar2.konkret2: The Shield flags risky wording before you hit send.
komunikaty.Filary.filar2.konkret3: The Ethical Seal gives a score and a certificate — proof, not just a feeling.
komunikaty.Filary.filar3.naglowek: A new team member knows what to do from day one
komunikaty.Filary.filar3.korzysc: Instead of explaining it all to every new person, the onboarding wizard does it for you.
komunikaty.Filary.filar3.konkret1: The onboarding wizard walks her through each stage — no help from you needed.
komunikaty.Filary.filar3.konkret2: First 90 Days: four phases with missions — she sees the road ahead of her.
komunikaty.Filary.filar3.konkret3: Achievements and badges keep her engaged long after the start.
komunikaty.Filary.filar4.naglowek: You see growth even after a hard day
komunikaty.Filary.filar4.korzysc: The Dashboard shows where things stand today, and your results carry proof that lasts.
komunikaty.Filary.filar4.konkret1: Your Wrapped sums up the period — you see what you actually got done.
komunikaty.Filary.filar4.konkret2: A goal with milestones tells you how far you’ve come and what’s next.
komunikaty.Filary.filar4.konkret3: The Testimony with its digital fingerprint stays — others can verify your results.
komunikaty.Cennik.naglowek: Plans differ in scope, not in promises
komunikaty.Cennik.wstep: Every plan is the same system. The difference is scope — from your first contacts to your whole team structure.
komunikaty.Cennik.plany.starter.dlaKogo: For you if you’re just starting and want a clear plan for every day.

komunikaty.Cennik.plany.starter.pozycja2: DMO — a Daily Action Plan that tells you what to do today
komunikaty.Cennik.plany.starter.pozycja3: Sign-up form with a public page — submissions go straight into your contact base
komunikaty.Cennik.plany.starter.pozycja4: Training Room — practice the hard answers before they come up for real
komunikaty.Cennik.plany.starter.pozycja5: Shield — catches risky wording before you send it

komunikaty.Cennik.plany.growth.pozycja2: You see the full tree of your team structure

komunikaty.Cennik.plany.pro.pozycja2: API keys and webhooks — connect Catherly to your own tools

komunikaty.Cennik.faq.p1: Which currency will I pay in?
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.o1: Prices on this page are in euros. Every plan also has a price in Polish złoty — you see the currency before you pay.
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.p2: What if my plan stops being the right fit?
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.o2: You choose a plan and change it whenever you like.
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.p3: What if I decide it’s not for me?
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.o3: You can cancel whenever you like. No reason needed.
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.p4: What about my contacts when I cancel?
komunikaty.Cennik.faq.o4: You export contacts to vCard and download your log as CSV — everything is yours.

komunikaty.ObrazyFilarow.filar1: The Daily Method of Operations (DMO) screen in the Catherly app: task counters for the day with targets and progress bars.
komunikaty.ObrazyFilarow.filar2: The Shield screen in the Catherly app: a pasted text promising earnings, with the risky phrases flagged below it and a corrected version offered.
komunikaty.ObrazyFilarow.filar3: The First 90 Days screen in the Catherly app: the phase, the day number, a progress bar and today's mission card.
komunikaty.ObrazyFilarow.filar4: The Your Wrapped screen in the Catherly app: a monthly summary slide with a counter of published posts.
komunikaty.DbanieOSiebie.tresc: You collect proof of your work on the Wall of Proof. It’s a space where you celebrate, not just measure.
komunikaty.Problem.naglowek: Everything is somewhere. Each thing somewhere else.
komunikaty.Problem.tresc: You write posts once the house is asleep. In the morning you hunt for a number you know you saved somewhere. You hear what’s happening in your team later than you’d like.
komunikaty.Problem.kropka: In the evening you sit down with a notebook and add up what came of it.
komunikaty.Definicja.naglowek: Catherly is the memory of your selling
komunikaty.Definicja.tresc: Catherly remembers what you’ve been carrying in your head and your notebooks: what you promised to whom, which content went to which customer, and what sold. Your team is close at hand too — you see who you’re bringing in and how she’s doing. You still sell your way, just not from memory anymore.
komunikaty.RytmDnia.naglowek: What your day with Catherly looks like
komunikaty.RytmDnia.krok1Tresc: You open your Daily Action Plan and start conversations in a set order. The calendar reminds you of the rest.
komunikaty.RytmDnia.krok2Tresc: You check your contact base and know what you promised to whom. You build your post from a template in Studio.
komunikaty.RytmDnia.krok3Tresc: On the Dashboard, your day and your team’s day sit side by side.
komunikaty.RytmDnia.kropka: In the evening you see what came of it.
komunikaty.CennikSkrot.roznica: Every plan keeps track of your contacts and results — Growth adds a view of your whole team.
komunikaty.Obawy.p1: What if I can’t get the hang of another new app?
komunikaty.Obawy.o1: The onboarding wizard takes you step by step. First 90 Days gives you a ready plan for the start.
komunikaty.Obawy.p2: What about the contacts I already keep in other places?
komunikaty.Obawy.o2: There’s no bulk import — you add contacts by hand or through the form. You can always export them to vCard.
komunikaty.Obawy.p3: If I stop paying, does my data disappear?
komunikaty.Obawy.o3: You can cancel whenever you like. Export contacts to vCard, download your log as CSV — everything is yours.
komunikaty.Obawy.p4: I hold my customers’ data. Who else sees it?
komunikaty.Obawy.o4: Only you have access to your account. The Shield keeps content ethical — the SHA-256 Testimony logs every change.
komunikaty.Obawy.p5: I hardly ever sit at a computer — will this work?
komunikaty.Obawy.o5: Built for the phone from day one — there’s no cut-down version. You open it and it works the way it should.
komunikaty.Obawy.p6: My company has its rules. Can I even use outside tools?
komunikaty.Obawy.o6: The Compliance Passport scans content against four jurisdictions’ rules — but your company’s IT has the final say.

komunikaty.ZamkniecieCennik.zdanie: Choose a plan and see how Catherly works in your day-to-day. Nothing ties you in — you can cancel whenever you like.
komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.h1: Features laid out the way your day runs
komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.zdanie: You choose what you need to do right now, and you’ll find the feature names along the way.
komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.blok1Naglowek: In the morning, you see who to reach out to.
komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.blok1Wprowadzenie: A day planned in the Daily Action Plan starts with something concrete. You keep your appointments, tasks and contacts in one place, not in your head.
komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.blok2Naglowek: You sit down to write your posts and don’t start from a blank page.

komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.blok3Naglowek: A new person joins your team, and you don’t explain it all over again.

komunikaty.FunkcjeIndeks.blok4Naglowek: In the evening, you know where you stand.

komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod1_nazwa: Sign-up form with a public page
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod1_poco: A friend asks you about working together, and instead of copying her details out of your messages, you send her the link to your form. She fills it in on a public page — and the submission goes straight into your contact base.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod1_nie: Catherly won’t email you about a new submission — you see completed submissions in the app.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod2_poco: Your conversation dates don’t have to live in your head. You plan contacts in the calendar, and within the last {minuty} minutes before the conversation Catherly reminds you about it.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod2_nie: Reminders don’t come by email or text message.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod3_poco: You glance at the calendar on your phone and see the conversations planned in Catherly next to everything else in your day. You don’t copy anything over — what you’ve planned is simply there.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod3_nie: The subscription works one way, toward your phone — Catherly doesn’t read your private calendar and takes nothing from it.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod4_poco: You’re heading to a meeting and want your customer’s number where it always is — on your phone. With one click you export your contacts to vCard, and you have them at hand even without opening the app.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod4_nie: The export works one way — there’s no bulk import; you add contacts by hand or through the form.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod5_poco: You finish a conversation and leave a business card — with your referral QR code on it instead of an address to retype. You create it in Catherly and add it to your materials and business cards when you export them.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod5_nie: Catherly doesn’t publish or send out materials with your code for you — you get a ready export, and you decide where the graphic or the printout goes.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod6_poco: You hand a friend an invitation with your code and get back to your day. You see in Catherly who used it — no need to keep asking whether anything came of it.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod6_nie: Catherly sends nothing to your friends — you pass the invitation on yourself, and the program only shows who used it.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod7_poco: A day planned in the Daily Action Plan starts with something concrete — you don’t wonder what’s next, you call, you write, you talk. Your plan carries you through the day.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod7_nie: The Daily Action Plan sends nothing for you — you call the people on your plan and write to them yourself.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod8_poco: After a conversation you save a task with the person it concerns: call back after the weekend, send the catalog, ask about the decision. You come back to the contact, and what you agreed is right there with it.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod8_nie: Catherly won’t remind you about a task by email — your task list is in the app.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod9_poco: Before a hard conversation, you step into the Training Room and give it a dry run — the objection comes up here first, not in front of your customer. You take your answers from a library of objections sorted into seven categories.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod9_nie: The Training Room doesn’t talk to your customer and sends her nothing — you practice here on your own, and it’s you who leads the real conversation.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod10_poco: Before a meeting you write down a conversation plan: what you’ll ask, what you’ll show, what matters to you. After the meeting you write a debrief — the details go into the note before the rest of the day pushes them out.
komunikaty.FunkcjePozyskiwanie.mod10_nie: Catherly won’t write the plan or the debrief for you — you write them yourself, in your own words.

komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.zdanie: The Studio learns your voice and makes sure no piece of content breaks your rules.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod1_poco: The same idea has to look good in a post and in print — and you don’t want to start from scratch every time. That’s what the Studio is for: safe zones and auto-layout make sure nothing important gets cut off in any format.

komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod2_poco: In the evening, you prepare a post, and instead of a blank page you open a ready template. You swap in your text, save your own version — and next time you start from that one.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod2_nie: Catherly won’t generate a template for you — you pick a ready one and adjust it your way.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod3_poco: You put a hashtag set together once and have it at hand for every post — you add it with one click. You don’t retype anything from old posts or from the notes on your phone.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod3_nie: Catherly won’t suggest hashtags for you — you decide what’s in a set and which post it goes with.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod4_poco: Every post idea gets its place and date in the calendar right away. You see what you’ve planned and for when, and when plans change, you move a post to another day — without rebuilding everything from scratch.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod4_nie: Catherly won’t publish a post for you — the calendar shows the plan, and you do the publishing yourself.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod5_poco: You send a finished post for approval — from that moment it’s with your leader. When she accepts or rejects it, you see it right away — no chasing her in messages.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod5_nie: Catherly won’t email you about your leader’s decision — you see the status in the app.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod6_poco: You catch risky wording before you publish, not after. The Shield’s rules run inside the app itself — your content never leaves it to be checked.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod6_nie: The Shield won’t fix the text for you — it points out risky wording, and what you do with it is your decision.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod7_poco: You finish a design, and it gets the Ethical Seal — an ethical score with a public certificate. At a meeting you show your customer the QR code: she scans it and sees the certificate for herself.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod7_nie: Catherly won’t send the certificate to your customer — who sees it and when is your decision.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod8_poco: You write posts the way you talk to your customers — in your own way. Catherly learns that style from your published posts and builds your brand’s voice profile from it.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod8_nie: Catherly won’t write your posts for you — the voice profile remembers your style, and you do the writing yourself, in your own words.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod9_poco: You come back to your posts after a few days and don’t have to guess where you left off. You filter the board and see right away what’s waiting for approval and what you’ve already scheduled.
komunikaty.FunkcjeTresci.mod9_nie: The board won’t show reach or likes — you see the status of your posts, and you check their results where you published them.

komunikaty.FunkcjeZespol.mod1_poco: A friend has decided to join your team, and your day is already full of your own conversations. You don’t sit down with her to go over every setting — the onboarding wizard walks her through six steps, from her profile and goals to a ready start.
komunikaty.FunkcjeZespol.mod1_nie: The wizard doesn’t move data over from other tools — the new person enters her profile and goals in it herself, step by step.

komunikaty.FunkcjeZespol.mod3_nie: Catherly won’t guide the new person for you — the program gives her missions and phases, and it’s you who leads the conversations.

komunikaty.FunkcjeZespol.mod6_nie: Catherly doesn’t come with ready-made training content — the Academy looks after the order of the modules, not what’s inside them.
